lines.en: Imaginary friends take the fall for you.
-Yeah, Ron. Go on, get up there. Have some fun.
-I recalibrated the sights on all the rifles
I've had enough fun for one day.
-Oh, I know that look. Where is she?
Preparing a ritual sacrifice of a newborn?
Oh, sorry, I pronounced that wrong.
-Diane, why don't you take the girls for some ice cream
while I dispose of the sewer-dwelling gutter witch?
This little domestic charade of yours
You're still the same old Ron Swanson.
I will defeat you right into my face.
